name: Middle pool · south double iron gate, curved head and tiled planter
trust: Separate southern entrance, not the southwest steps of IMG_2333. IMG_2334 shows two open iron leaves below a shallow curved white rendered head with sparse metal pergola frame above, crazy paving and a flush drain. IMG_2335 shows a raised planter flanking a recessed white step and a white tiled panel framed with blue/yellow patterned tiles. Placement follows the gap between unchanged registry blocks southeast of the camera pins, rather than treating GPS as a gate coordinate. Position (roughly 1–2 m), opening, heights, planter ends and shallow step dimensions are estimates; no grade change or enclosing wall beyond the photographed fragment is inferred. Tile motifs are schematic, not photo textures.
